channel.title: bzlab — VIDA
channel.description: My research experience at NYU Visualization Imaging and Data Analysis Center.

item.title: Redesigning for the Second Round
item.description: Scaling the corpus up meant fixing what the pilot exposed — trimming facets, taking the title out of query generation, and proving that a max-combining scoring rule hadn't collapsed the comparison.

item.title: Lessons from the Pilot Run
item.description: What a small first run taught me about sampling as a design decision, reading generated queries by hand, and not letting a three-dimensional table fool me.

item.title: A Benchmark for Descriptions in the Wild
item.description: Juliana's proposed research direction, and my first pass at what such a benchmark would have to cover — query dimensions, query styles, baselines — and what could quietly rig it.

item.title: Refactoring Auctus Pipeline
item.description: Exposing Auctus through an API, decoupling Profile from Description in the pipeline, and tightening how we use GitHub.

item.title: Building a Retrieval Benchmark on NYC Open Data
item.description: A focused review of ~36 papers on how to scientifically construct queries and graded relevance judgments (qrels) for a dataset-retrieval benchmark on NYC Open Data.

item.title: Post-Integration
item.description: A review of two related papers PI Juliana pointed me to after the AutoDDG–Auctus integration, and what they mean for AutoDDG's next steps.

item.title: Integrating AutoDDG into Auctus
item.description: How I integrated AutoDDG into Auctus v2: where it fits in the pipeline, the design decisions along the way, and shipping it to PyPI.

item.title: Auctus
item.description: A read-through of Auctus: its purpose, architecture, and usage.

item.title: AutoDDG (Automated Dataset Description Generation)
item.description: A read-through of AutoDDG: its background, two-stage architecture, and evaluation.
